name: Photo Map Embed
author: ahninternational

sections.description:
Photo Map Embed lets you convert photo GPS (EXIF) data into an interactive map that you can embed anywhere in WordPress — using a Gutenberg block or a shortcode.

Upload one or more photos containing GPS coordinates, and the plugin (or the free builder at photomapembed.com) instantly generates a shareable map with markers for each location. The embedded maps are lightweight, privacy-friendly, and work seamlessly on both desktop and mobile.

Free embeds include a small “Powered by Photo Map Embed” credit link.

✨ Features

  • Converts photo EXIF GPS to shareable Leaflet maps
  • Interactive map preview in Gutenberg
  • Copy-paste embed or use shortcode
  • Customizable style (street, satellite, etc.)
  • Lightweight and privacy-friendly
  • Works with images from iPhone, Android, or DSLR (with GPS)

For bulk upload and free online builder, visit photomapembed.com.

Privacy

Photo Map Embed does not collect or store user data. The optional builder (photomapembed.com) uses privacy-friendly analytics via Umami.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the ZIP, or search for “Photo Map Embed” under Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Photo Map Embed to configure defaults (optional).
  4. In the Block Editor, add the Photo Map Embed block and paste a Map ID or embed URL.
sections.faq:
Where do I get a Map ID?

You can create one for free at photomapembed.com by uploading your geotagged photos.

Can I embed maps without GPS in photos?

If a photo has no GPS data, you can manually place markers on the builder page before embedding.

Does it track users?

Tracking is disabled by default. The builder uses Umami analytics only for aggregate usage statistics — no personal data is collected.

Can I use this plugin on commercial sites?

Yes. Photo Map Embed is open-source and licensed under GPLv2 or later.
